definitions.explanation: The Japanese syllabary writing systems, including hiragana and katakana. Contrasts with kanji (Chinese characters).

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{仮名|かな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
{仮名|かな}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いてください→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{平仮名|ひらがな}→平仮名：02949_hiragana⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{片仮名|かたかな}→片仮名：02866_katakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{仮名|かな}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Hiragana and katakana together are called kana.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読み：00425_yomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仮名|かな}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}きなさい→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Write the reading of this kanji in kana.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仮名|かな}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
WRITING: Can also be written as かな in hiragana.

TYPES:
- ⟦{平仮名|ひらがな}→平仮名：02949_hiragana⟧ (hiragana) - cursive syllabary
- ⟦{片仮名|かたかな}→片仮名：02866_katakana⟧ (katakana) - angular syllabary

ETYMOLOGY: {仮|か} means 'temporary/borrowed' and {名|な} means 'name/character'. Kana were originally simplified forms of ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧ used for their phonetic value.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仮名|かな}⟦{遣|づか}い→仮名遣い：noentry⟧ (kana orthography)
- {仮名|かな}⟦{書|が}き→仮名書き：noentry⟧ (writing in kana)
